definition: Predicting how long a hospital patient will remain admitted — a healthcare operations task aiding capacity and care planning.
details: Predicting how long a hospital patient will remain admitted — a healthcare operations task aiding capacity and care planning.

explainer.lead: Length-of-Stay prediction estimates how long a hospital patient will remain admitted. It supports capacity management and care planning in healthcare operations.

tiers.eli5: It's guessing how many days a patient will need to stay in hospital, so the staff can plan beds and schedules ahead of time.
tiers.practitioner: The prediction feeds operational tasks such as capacity and care planning; a pitfall is that operational targets depend on it being reliable, so its accuracy has downstream consequences.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as predicting how long a hospital patient will remain admitted — a healthcare operations task aiding capacity and care planning.

explainer.example: A hospital uses a length-of-stay prediction for an incoming patient to reserve a bed for the expected number of days, aiding ward capacity planning.
